speaker: narrator
text: Part five. Mr. Gray stole *Bit*.

speaker: narrator
text: Back at camp, Jay doesn't say *a word*.

speaker: friend
text: Hey. We'll get your toaster *back*.

speaker: hero
text: He's not a toaster. He's my *best friend*.

speaker: soldier
text: Then we go back. No phones. No radios. *Nothing*.

speaker: hero
text: And then what? Ask Gray *nicely*?

speaker: narrator
text: Doctor Ada drops a book on the *table*.

speaker: scientist
text: The zombie fungus has an enemy. Another *fungus*.

speaker: scientist
text: It attacks the zombie fungus. Fewer spores *spread*.

speaker: hero
text: So we need a virus... that eats the *virus*.

speaker: scientist
text: A patch. Sent from the same tower. At *noon*.

speaker: scientist
text: I wrote it weeks ago. On *this*.

speaker: friend
text: Then why didn't you *use* it?

speaker: scientist
text: Someone has to plug it in. *On the roof*.

speaker: narrator
text: That night, Jay stares at the tower. *Alone*.

speaker: narrator
text: The tower light *blinks*. Short. Short. *Long*.

speaker: soldier
text: That's *Morse code*. Someone's talking.

speaker: narrator
text: Rook writes it down, letter by *letter*.

speaker: narrator
text: J. A. Y. Still *here*.

speaker: narrator
text: Part six drops in two days.
